text: Android: several accounts in the UI: start screen, Accounts screen, grouped overview, invite routing (B2)

From the B1 review (T-291), to settle in B2: (1) lists are keyed by the server's list id, so two accounts on the SAME server that share a list would collide on the primary key and mergeList keeps the first account's row. Recommendation: allow one account per server (the add-account form refuses a second one on a server this phone already has, with a message), which keeps the schema; re-keying lists by (accountId, id) is the alternative if the maintainer wants several logins per server. (2) LoginViewModel.login still calls authRepository.removeOtherAccounts(keep) to mirror the old wipe; B2's add-account path must not, and the start screen's sign-in for a phone with no account may. (3) Collaborator notifications carry the account id but not yet the label; show the label only when more than one account exists. (4) The CurrentAccount shim reads the first server account in sortOrder; remove it as the ticket says. (5) On a fresh install the typed server URL is now saved only on a successful login; a failed first attempt plus a restart falls back to the default suggestion. Fine for B2's start screen, but keep it in mind.
